export_meta.note: Structured to mirror the REAL Gnani Agents Console tab layout (Agent Details, System Prompt, Conversation Flow, Transcriber, LLM Model, Voice, Analytics, FAQ Answers), based on a live configuration session documented in gnani_config/CONSOLE_FINDINGS.md. There is no 'export existing agent' action in the Console UI, but the Console DOES support 'Import an Agent (.json upload)' as a creation mode — this file is positioned as an import-compatible / reference document for that flow, not a literal Console-generated export. All secrets are environment/secret references. No real API keys are present in this file.

requirement_to_console_mapping.note: The assignment mandates Gnani Prisma ASR, Gnani Timbre 2.5 TTS, and Gnani Evon LLM. In this Console tenant, 'Prisma' and 'Timbre 2.5' are not exposed as selectable models; the Gnani-native model actually offered in each slot was selected in every case, so the 'all three components are Gnani-native' requirement is satisfied at the tenant-configuration level. Prisma and Timbre 2.5 should be enabled by Gnani for this tenant/reviewer account. Swapping to the exact-named model, once available, is a one-field change (asr.model / tts.model below, or GNANI_ASR_MODEL / GNANI_TTS_MODEL env vars for the backend).

components.note: 'Prisma' does not appear anywhere in the Transcriber tab's provider/model UI. 'Responsive' is the only Gnani-native ASR model offered in this tenant and was selected as the closest/only native match.

'Timbre 2.5' does not exist in this tenant. 'Gnani Timbre G v1.0' is the only Gnani-native TTS model offered and was selected as the closest/only native match. Voice options under this model: Elena (Female), Jenny (Female), John (Male), Lucia (Female) — Jenny selected per the requirement for a female voice.

Exact match. 'Gnani Evon v2.0 Fast' is the Console's pre-selected default for new agents; it was changed to plain 'Gnani Evon v2.0' to match the assignment's 'Evon' requirement precisely, rather than keeping a Fast/Ultra variant.

post_call_data_extraction.description: Extract the final call outcome and key details from each call transcript.
post_call_data_extraction.known_console_defect: Saving with this section enabled returned 'Failed to update agent detail(s)' during the live session, even with a single valid-looking Enum field populated. It was left disabled to preserve a clean saved state ('Agent detail(s) updated successfully'). See gnani_config/CONSOLE_FINDINGS.md for details.

field_definitions_intended.field_description: Final disposition stage code for the call, chosen only from explicit customer statements.
field_definitions_intended.extraction_instruction: Select exactly one stage code based only on explicit customer statements in the transcript. Never infer or assume. Commitment codes (PTP_*, ALREADY_PAID, CALLBACK_SCHEDULED, DISPUTE_*, NO_LOAN, RTP_*, WRONG_NUMBER, THIRD_PARTY) require a verbatim evidence quote from a customer turn; if no such quote exists, fall back to UNCLEAR (or BUSY/RNR/VM/DSCN for non-verbal call outcomes). See prompts/03-analytics-prompt.md for full tie-breaker rules.

field_definitions_intended.field_description: One-sentence factual reason for the disposition, based on what the customer said.
field_definitions_intended.extraction_instruction: Write one sentence (<= 200 characters) stating what the customer explicitly said. Do not include your own inference or speculation.

field_definitions_intended.field_description: 2-4 sentence factual summary of the call.
field_definitions_intended.extraction_instruction: Summarize the call in 2-4 sentences, strictly factual, no speculation about intent beyond what was said.

field_definitions_intended.field_description: ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) the customer committed to pay, or null.
field_definitions_intended.extraction_instruction: Resolve relative date expressions ('today', 'tomorrow', 'next week', weekday names, explicit dates) against call_metadata.call_date. Output ISO 8601 only. Leave null if no explicit date/commitment was stated, even if the stage_code implies one should exist.

field_definitions_intended.field_description: Amount the customer committed to pay, or null.
field_definitions_intended.extraction_instruction: Only populate if the customer stated a specific amount. Never fabricate an amount; leave null otherwise.

field_definitions_intended.field_description: ISO 8601 datetime for a requested callback, or null.
field_definitions_intended.extraction_instruction: Populate only if the customer gave a specific day and/or time window for a callback (even approximate, e.g. 'this evening'). Resolve to ISO 8601. Leave null otherwise.

field_definitions_intended.field_description: Whether the customer's identity was affirmatively confirmed.
field_definitions_intended.extraction_instruction: True only if the transcript shows the customer affirmatively acknowledging their identity (e.g. 'yes, this is Rahul', 'sí, soy yo'). A non-denial is not sufficient evidence.

field_definitions_intended.field_description: Overall customer sentiment during the call.
field_definitions_intended.extraction_instruction: Classify overall customer sentiment across the call as positive, neutral, or negative based on tone and content of customer turns only.

field_definitions_intended.field_description: Verbatim substring from a customer turn supporting the stage_code, or null.
field_definitions_intended.extraction_instruction: Copy an exact, character-for-character substring from a customer-speaker turn's text that supports the chosen stage_code. If no such substring exists for a commitment code, the stage_code must not be used — fall back to UNCLEAR/BUSY/RNR/VM/DSCN instead and leave this null.

field_definitions_intended.field_description: Calibrated confidence (0.0-1.0) in the stage_code decision.
field_definitions_intended.extraction_instruction: 0.9-1.0 for explicit unambiguous statements with clean evidence; 0.6-0.89 for clear statements with minor ambiguity; below 0.6 for weak/partially-inferred signals (favor UNCLEAR instead of forcing a higher-confidence code).

post_call_data_extraction.note: Field definitions derived from prompts/03-analytics-prompt.md. Intended to be entered once the Console-side save defect is fixed; the backend independently re-validates stage_code, evidence_quote and dates in app/services/stage_code.py regardless of Console-side output, per CONTRACT.md.

faq_answers.description: Set predefined answers for user queries (Only available for English and Hindi).
faq_answers.limitation_note: Spanish is not supported by this feature, despite this agent being bilingual English (US) / Spanish. Documented as a known console limitation — not used for this agent since Spanish coverage would be incomplete.

engines_env_mapping.note: The backend (app/) intentionally uses assignment-identifier env values (gnani-prisma / gnani-timbre-2.5 / gnani-evon) as configurable defaults. These are NOT hardcoded — they are read from environment variables and can be repointed at this tenant's real Console model IDs with no code changes.

secrets_used: GNANI_API_KEY (Gnani Console API auth, secret manager reference only)
WEBHOOK_API_KEY (X-Webhook-Key header for post-call webhook, secret manager reference only)
security.note: No plaintext secrets in this file. All values of the form ${VAR} or ${secrets.VAR} are resolved at deploy/runtime from environment variables or a secret manager, per .env.example. The Console's own Headers table for the Post-Call Trigger was intentionally left empty in the shared account for this same reason.
